As you know, I have the draft in front of me requesting 10 laptops, a commercial cloud music platform, $8,000 from the general fund, and installation on September 1, 2026. Before I make my final approval decision, I'd like to hear from each of you on any relevant findings. Could the requesting teacher, our instructional technology specialist, and the business-office manager please share your reports?

transcript.text: Dr. Monroe, I have a finding to report from my completed network and privacy review. The commercial cloud music platform requested in the draft proposal cannot be used with student accounts. Instead, the district-managed SoundLab EDU platform is approved for this purpose, and it requires managed student accounts plus a security configuration record. I closed the technology review ticket this week, but it has not yet been linked to the purchasing request.

transcript.text: Dr. Monroe, I have a finding to report from the business office. I've confirmed that the Arts Innovation Grant will fund this project, but only up to exactly $6,800 — not the $8,000 from the general fund currently in the draft. Additionally, the grant requires that the purchase order be issued by August 20, 2026. Under the grant's purchasing sequence, the purchase order must be followed by procurement and setup, which means September 15, 2026 is the earliest feasible installation date, not September 1. I received the grant award notice this week and filed it in the business-office grant folder, but I should note the funding details have not yet been added to the proposal.
